product_overview: AIDA is a local-first AI-assisted data analysis tool that rapidly inspects data files (csv, parquet, json), auto-generates reproducible Python analysis scripts, and visualizes insights with rich charts and narratives, all running on the user's machine for privacy and control.
core_goals: Provide zero-setup insights by allowing users to point to data files and quickly get meaningful charts, statistics, and narrative summaries within minutes.
Generate deterministic, reproducible Python scripts that can be versioned, audited, and customized for further analysis.
Maintain a privacy-first local workflow with pluggable model providers configurable via environment variables.
Offer a user-friendly frontend with clear UX for file upload/selection, sampling controls, script previews, and results visualization.
key_features: Multi-format data support: CSV (with delimiter and encoding inference), Parquet (via pyarrow), and JSON (line-delimited recommended).
Lightweight data inspection with schema inference, sampling strategies (head, tail, random), and basic profiling shown in an inspect panel.
Automated Python script code generation using LLMs, producing reproducible and configurable analysis scripts targeting pandas or polars engines and plotly or seaborn visualizations.
Script execution in isolated environments producing HTML reports and individual image artifacts.
Comprehensive frontend implemented in React + Vite with a core DataAnalyzer component managing end-to-end states from file selection to results display.
Backend Python CLI supporting inspect, generate, and execute commands with a lightweight Bun server bridging frontend and backend via HTTP APIs.
Robust testing strategy including unit, integration, end-to-end, and contract tests using Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, and MSW.
Detailed session persistence, optimistic updates, accessible keyboard navigation, and performance optimizations like virtualized tables, streamed logs, and debounced prompt recompositions.
user_flow_summary: User selects or drags-and-drops a local data file in the frontend UI, optionally overriding detected format.
System performs lightweight inspection sampling the data, shows schema, sample rows, and profiling stats with controls for sampling strategy and row limits.
User initiates Python script generation where the prompt composer builds context and an LLM generates a deterministic script tailored to the dataset.
Generated script is saved and executed in an isolated environment producing HTML reports and charts; execution logs stream live to the frontend.
Frontend displays the generated script for review and provides options to copy or download it.
Results panel presents visual charts and narrative insights interactively, with links to full HTML reports.
validation_criteria: Verify support and correct handling of csv, parquet, and json local data files including large file warnings and sampling limits.
Ensure the script generation is deterministic, reproducible, and respects configuration options (engine, visualization library).
Automate tests verifying full UX flows: idle to inspection, generation, execution, and success or failure states.
Validate that backend APIs (inspect, generate, execute) communicate properly with frontend with correct payloads and streaming of logs.
Accessibility tests confirming keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and focus order across UI controls.
Performance benchmarks ensuring smooth rendering of large samples with virtualized tables and streaming data updates.
Security checks preventing network egress by default and proper sanitization and cleanup of temporary paths and artifacts.
